_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/casting/test_exile_spell_on_resolution.py. t_foundry is Forger's Foundry's mana ability: blue mana whose spending on a small instant or sorcery offers to exile that spell as it resolves, linked to the Foundry.

cards.name: Test Foundry
cards.oracle_text: {T}: Add {U}. When you spend this mana to cast an instant or sorcery spell with mana value 3 or less, you may exile that spell instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard as it resolves.

abilities.text: {T}: Add {U}. When you spend this mana to cast an instant or sorcery spell with mana value 3 or less, you may exile that spell instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard as it resolves.
